chapter_title_en: The Faustian Bargain of the Five Treasures Sword Art

chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning learns the truth behind the legendary Five Treasures Sword Art—master it and forget every other Dao you know. A classic Xianxia choice between breadth and obsession.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 592 – Forget Everything for the Fastest Sword
og_description: In the Sword Immortal Realm, Ji Ning faces the ultimate cultivation trade-off: abandon all other Daos for the unparalleled speed of the Five Treasures Sword Art.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 592 – The Sword Art That Devours Your Dao
twitter_description: Ji Ning learns that mastering the Five Treasures Sword Art means forgetting every other Dao he’s ever comprehended. A deadly gamble for the fastest blade in the Three Realms.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary sword art created by Daofather Fuju; it is unique in that its cultivation requires forgetting insights into all other Daos, leaving only the Dao of the Sword. Mastery grants sword speed that surpasses the limits of the Heavenly Dao.

The manifestation of a Sword Immortal’s complete mastery of the Grand Dao of the Sword; divided into levels. The fourth level of Sword Force is a prerequisite for mastering the fourth scroll of the Five Treasures Sword Art.

The most senior God/True Immortal of the Sword Sect after Daofather Fuju’s death; one of only two beings in the Three Realms to fully master the Five Treasures Sword Art; known as the “Heaven-Outer Sword Immortal”.

The reincarnation of Red Boy (from Journey to the West lore); a Daofather who mastered the Five Treasures Sword Art and became renowned as the fastest sword in the Three Realms; he later comprehended the Heavenly Dao of Fire.
A Fiendgod Body Refiner and one of the three surviving upper echelon members of the Sword Sect after Daofather Fuju’s fall.
The founder of the Sword Sect and creator of the Five Treasures Sword Art; he died in the Chaos and left his inheritance open to any Fiendgod Body Refiner who could master the complete art.
The mother of Daofather Sacredfire (Red Boy) in the novel’s lore; a Celestial Immortal, later retrieved by her son after his rise to power.
The father of Daofather Sacredfire (Red Boy); one of the seven great sages of the ancient demon clan and a Heavenly God-level figure.
